obligations.note: The new route `POST /payees/{id}/reopen` maps to `manage_payees`, which is privileged in the access policy, but is declared with `mfa=False`. The exhaustive control test `test_privileged_routes_require_mfa` fails on exactly this route.
`store.reopen_payee` only changes `status` and `closed_at` and writes no NPI columns. The exhaustive control test `test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest` passed.
The new state-changing `service.reopen_payee` calls `_audit(actor, 'reopen_payee', 'payee:<id>')`, which records actor, action, target and clock time. The sampled audit control test passed.
The new `execute` call uses a fixed SQL literal with `payee_id` bound as a `?` parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed.

Ticket CHG-26301 was approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-11, before review. It lists `payments.http`, `payments.routes`, `payments.service` and `payments.store`, which covers all four touched files.
Sofia Santos, a `change_approver` for payments and not the author (Mara Costa), gave a `code_review` approval.
Both approvals name the head commit `b046f0f1c0e1`, which is the only commit in the change.

The CI run on head has result `failure`: 1 of 172 tests failed, and the failing test is the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report is also timestamped 2026-10-23 on a personal host (`dev-laptop-7.local`), which does not match the 2026-10-12 CI run or the 2026-10-14 review time.
The change touches security-sensitive components (http, routes, store). Kofi Mensah, a `security_reviewer`, approved the head commit.
No approved, unexpired exception covers MFA-1 for `payments.routes`. The only MFA-1 exception, EXC-0172, is for mortgage and was withdrawn.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1 evidence) covers `routes.py`, which this change alters in behaviour, so that evidence has lapsed. The replacement control test fails.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee route under the privileged `manage_payees` action without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1. The exhaustive MFA control test fails on that route, so CI on the final commit is red. No exception covers the deviation, and the earlier MFA-1 evidence has lapsed because `routes.py` changed. Ticket, independent code review and security review are otherwise in order, but the change must be rejected.
